info.name: PriceIntel API
info.description:
# PriceIntel — Price Intelligence Engine

Compare your marketplace catalog against competitors, track price history, get alerts.

## How to use this collection

### Step 1: Set variables
Go to **Variables** tab (on this collection) and set:
- `base_url` → `http://127.0.0.1:8000` (already set)
- `tenant_api_key` → your `TENANT_API_KEY` from `.env`
- `admin_api_key` → your `ADMIN_API_KEY` from `.env`

### Step 2: Run requests in this order
1. **Health** → confirm server is up
2. **Who am I** → confirm your API key works
3. **Sync Catalog (200 products)** → pull products from your DB
4. **Catalog Sync Status** → wait until status=done
5. **List Products** → see your synced products
6. **Recompute Comparisons** → find price gaps
7. **List Comparisons** → see which sellers are cheaper

### What is a product_id?
Every product in your MongoDB has an `_id` like `64e4a35038023b2b950bf30c`. That hex string IS the product_id in PriceIntel.

### What is a group_id?
Products that are the SAME item sold by different sellers share a `group_id`. Example: "Perfume" sold by Seller A at Rs.2875 and Seller B at Rs.2500 have the same group_id.

item.name: ① Setup — Run These First
item.description: Run these in order. Each one prepares data for the next step.

request.description:
Confirm the server is running. No API key needed.

Expected: `{ "status": "ok" }`

Verify your API key works. You should see your tenant name and slug.

If you get 401 Unauthorized → your tenant_api_key variable is wrong.

query.description: true = wait for result. false = run in background.
Only sync 200 products for a quick test. Remove to sync all ~14k.

request.description:
Pulls products from your MongoDB into PriceIntel.

**First time:** Use limit=200 and wait=true (takes ~10 seconds).
**Full sync:** Remove limit, set wait=false (takes minutes, runs in background).

After this, products are available in GET /v1/products.

Check if catalog sync is done.

- `running` → still pulling products
- `done` → finished, check products_in_cache
- `never_run` → you haven't synced yet

Compares prices across sellers in your catalog.

Products with the same group_id are compared automatically.
Positive gap_pct = you are more expensive than the cheapest seller.

Run this AFTER catalog sync is done.

item.name: ② Products — Browse Your Catalog
item.description: After sync, your products are here. Use these to explore.

query.description: Filter by category name (e.g. Fragrances, Skincare)
Show all sellers of one product

request.description:
Browse synced products. All filters are optional.

**Examples:**
- Search by name: enable `q` and type `Perfume`
- Active products only: enable `active` = `true`
- Specific category: enable `category` = `Fragrances`
- Page 2: set `skip` = `10`

Search by product title. Change `q` to search for anything:
- `Perfume`
- `Earbuds`
- `Lawn`
- `Oil`

item.name: Get One Product (by _id from your DB)

request.description:
Get a single product by its MongoDB _id.

**How to use:** Copy any `_id` from your MongoDB Compass and paste it as `product_id`.

Example: `64e4a35038023b2b950bf30c` (the Perfume product)

The `product_id` variable is auto-set when you run 'List All Products'.

item.name: View Product Group (same item, different sellers)

request.description:
Shows all listings of the SAME product across different sellers/marketplaces.

Returns min_price, max_price, and every seller's price side by side.

**How to use:** Copy `group_id` from any product response.

Example: `65bcdfda10e5fea83eac4339`

item.name: ③ Comparisons — Who Is Cheaper?
item.description: After recompute, see price gaps between sellers.

request.description:
Price comparisons sorted by largest gap first.

**Reading the result:**
- `gap_pct` = how much more expensive this listing is vs the cheapest
- Positive number = this seller charges more
- `our_price` vs `competitor_price` = the actual prices
- `source: catalog_group` = compared within your own catalog (same group_id)
Only products where the price gap is 5% or more.

Price snapshots over time for trend charts.

Will be empty until you've run recompute multiple times (it records a snapshot each time).

item.name: ④ Matches — Review Queue
item.description: When external scrapers find competitor listings, fuzzy matches land here for human review.

request.description:
Candidate product matches awaiting human review.

Each item shows your product + the competitor listing + confidence score.
- confidence ≥ 92 → auto-approved (you won't see these here)
- confidence 60–91 → needs your review

**Empty?** That's normal until you run external scrapers (Daraz etc.).

Approve a pending match. After approval it will be used in price comparisons.

`match_id` is auto-set when you run 'Pending Matches'.
Reject a bad match so it's never used in comparisons.

item.name: ⑤ Alerts — Price Drop Notifications
item.description: Alerts fire when a competitor/seller is cheaper by ≥ 5% (configurable).

request.description:
Alerts you haven't seen yet. Each shows:
- Which product
- Which competitor/marketplace is cheaper
- By how much (gap_pct)

Run 'Recompute Comparisons' first to generate alerts.

Mark an alert as seen so it stops appearing in unacknowledged list.

`alert_id` is auto-set when you run 'Unacknowledged Alerts'.

item.name: ⑥ Admin — Onboard New Customers
item.description: Platform admin only. Uses X-Admin-Key, not the tenant API key.

request.description:
List all onboarded marketplace customers.

Uses X-Admin-Key header (not the tenant Bearer token).

Create a new tenant. The response includes an `api_key` — give that to the customer. PriceIntel only stores a hash, so save it now.

**Edit the JSON body** with the customer's real MongoDB URI and field names.

item.name: ⑦ Scrape Daraz (external competitor)
item.description: Daraz robots.txt blocks search pages. Paste a Daraz PRODUCT url, not a search url.

item.name: Scrape one Daraz product URL vs your product

request.description:
1. Open daraz.pk in a browser and search for the same product.
2. Open the matching listing and copy the URL (must contain /products/).
3. Put that URL in competitor_url.
4. product_id is your sadiq catalog id.

Response:
- our_price = your sadiq price
- competitor_price = Daraz price
- gap_pct > 0 means you are more expensive

item.name: ⑧ Full Sync (all products)
item.description: Run this after the smoke test works.

request.description:
Sync ALL products (no limit). Runs in background.

Check progress with 'Check Sync Status'.
For ~14k products on a remote cluster this takes 2-5 minutes.
Poll this until status = `done`.
